difference_sign_convention.primary: delta_c_minus_b = S_c(C) - S_c(B); negative means Arm C is lower/better for that cell
difference_sign_convention.secondary_b_vs_t121: delta_b_minus_t121 = S_c(B) - S_c(T121); negative means Arm B is lower/better
difference_sign_convention.secondary_c_vs_t121: delta_c_minus_t121 = S_c(C) - S_c(T121); negative means Arm C is lower/better

integrity_policy.aggregation: arithmetic mean over exact 150 frozen cells only; no weighting or filtering
